instruction: Can you help me set Evince as the default PDF viewer on this Ubuntu system?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Evince as default PDF viewer. Evaluator checks xdg-mime setting for application/pdf MIME type to verify evince.desktop is registered. Similar complexity to original VLC task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: uses 'xdg-mime query default application/pdf' which is the standard command to query default PDF application on Ubuntu
Metric logic is correct: check_include_exclude properly checks if 'evince.desktop' is in the result string
Data flow is correct: getter returns desktop file name (e.g., 'evince.desktop\n'), metric checks if 'evince.desktop' is included
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies that Evince is set as default PDF viewer by checking the MIME type association
Expected value is semantically correct: 'evince.desktop' is the correct desktop file identifier for Evince
Parameter handling is correct: metric function receives rules dict directly when expected.type='rule', and correctly accesses rules.get('include', [])
